name: Mader Group Limited
summary: Mader Group Limited, a contracting company, provides specialist technical services in the mining, energy, and industrial sectors in Australia, North America, and internationally. The company offers fabrication and line boring; electrical services; and maintenance and support services for mobile, fixed, and coal handling processing plants. It also provides Infrastructure solutions for defence, utilities, and construction maintenance services. In addition, the company offers maintenance services for rail, road transport, marine and preventative equipment, and heavy haulage.
